blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Transforming binary masks into geometric contours remains a critical step in many computer vision pipelines, particularly for post-processing high-resolution segmentation outputs. Yet, standard algorithms such as the Suzuki-Abe method are limited by their sequential nature and the overhead of building topological hierarchies. As modern applications transition to high-resolution imaging, there is a critical need for contour extraction that leverages multi-core CPU architectures without the complexity of tile stitching or heavy synchronization.
  This paper presents TRUCO (Threaded Raster Unrestricted Contour Ownership), a lock-free parallel algorithm designed for high-performance geometric boundary extraction. TRUCO introduces a start-point ownership rule, combined with a speculative tracing model, in which threads trace contours downward into adjacent regions and use an upward-termination logic to ensure each contour is processed exactly once.
  Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets, conducted on both consumer and server-grade CPUs, demonstrate that TRUCO significantly outperforms existing baselines. The method achieves speedups of over an order of magnitude compared to the industry standard while maintaining robust scalability on high-resolution scenes across diverse hardware architectures.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Binary image contour extraction is a fundamental prerequisite for a wide array of computer vision applications, ranging from shape analysis and optical character recognition (OCR) [ 7 , 21 , 1 ] to fiducial marker detection [ 26 , 20 ] and robotic vision [ 6 , 16 ] . Standard algorithms, most notably the topological structural analysis algorithm by Suzuki and Abe [ 28 ] , have served as the industry standard for decades. However, the landscape of digital imaging has shifted dramatically since these algorithms were conceived. Modern applications increasingly demand the processing of high-resolution images (4K and beyond) in real time, placing significant strain on traditional serial processing pipelines.
blocks.zh: 二进制图像轮廓提取是众多计算机视觉应用的基本前提,从形状分析和光学字符识别(OCR)[7,21,1]到微分标记检测[26,20]和机器人视觉[6,16]. 标准算法,最显著的是铃木和安倍[28]的地形结构分析算法,几十年来一直作为行业标准. 然而,自这些算法被构思以来,数字成像的地貌发生了巨大的变化. 现代应用越来越多地要求实时处理高分辨率图像(4K及以后),给传统的串行处理管道带来很大压力.

blocks.en: The primary bottleneck in standard contour extraction is its sequential nature and the high computational cost of establishing topological hierarchies (i.e., determining parent-child relationships between contours). While this topological information is valuable for specific tasks, many high-performance applications require only the geometric boundaries of objects, making hierarchical computation an unnecessary overhead. Furthermore, as central processing units (CPUs) have evolved toward multi-core architectures, legacy single-threaded algorithms fail to exploit the available hardware parallelism, limiting the overall system throughput.
blocks.zh: 标准轮廓提取中的主要瓶颈是它的顺序性质和建立地形等级的高昂计算成本(即确定轮廓之间的亲子关系). 虽然这种地形信息对具体任务很有价值,但许多高性能的应用只需要对象的几何边界,使得分级计算成为不必要的间接费用. 此外,随着中央处理单元(CPUs)向多核心架构发展,遗留的单脚算法未能利用现有的硬件平行性,限制了整个系统的吞吐量.

blocks.en: While the literature presents several parallel strategies to accelerate this process [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , a significant gap remains between theoretical proposals and practical utility. Most existing parallel alternatives are either computationally complex or lack publicly available implementations, making them inaccessible in real-world scenarios. For instance, even the industry-standard OpenCV library [ 2 ] currently lacks a native parallel implementation for contour extraction.
blocks.zh: 虽然文献提出了加速这一进程的若干平行战略[8、9、10、11],但理论建议与实际效用之间仍存在很大差距。 大多数现有的平行替代品要么在计算上复杂,要么缺乏可公开获取的实施,因此在现实世界中无法使用。 例如,就连工业标准OpenCV库[2]目前也缺乏本地并行的对等提取执行。

blocks.en: In this paper, we present TRUCO, a high-performance parallel algorithm for contour tracing that optimizes the fundamental Suzuki-Abe method [ 28 ] for multi-core architectures. Our approach utilizes a deterministic vertical partitioning strategy governed by a unidirectional tracing constraint. By enforcing a strict start-point ownership rule, we eliminate the need for complex boundary stitching or synchronization primitives often found in tile-based approaches. Since the algorithm relies on a benign race condition model where tracing operations are idempotent—the outcome of multiple threads marking the same pixel is identical to a single thread doing so—threads can modify the shared image buffer concurrently without the need for mutexes or atomic hardware instructions. Threads are permitted to trace contours downwards into adjacent regions speculatively, but are governed by an upward termination logic: a trace must abort immediately if the path traverses upward into a preceding thread’s domain. This mechanism ensures that every contour is extracted exactly once by the thread that contains its raster-scan entry point, effectively resolving the double-counting problem inherent in parallel processing. Consequently, TRUCO delivers a lock-free, high-throughput solution tailored for applications that require geometric boundary data, without the computational burden of constructing a topological hierarchy. Furthermore, by restricting the state space to 8-bit operations rather than the 32-bit integer labeling required by the standard Suzuki-Abe algorithm, TRUCO achieves higher SIMD throughput and reduced memory-bandwidth pressure, providing a performance advantage that is independent of thread count.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了TRUCO,一种高性能的平行算法,用于轮廓追踪,优化了基础铃木-阿贝方法[28],用于多核心架构. 我们的方法采用一种由单向追踪制约所支配的确定性纵向划分战略。 通过执行严格的起始点所有权规则,我们消除了在基于瓦片的方法中经常发现的复杂边界缝合或同步原始的需要. 由于算法依赖于一个良性种族条件模型,在这种模型中,追踪操作具有偶数性——标记同一像素的多个线程的结果与一个线程相同,因此线程可以同时修改共享的图像缓冲,而不需要变异或原子硬件指令. 线程被允许以投机方式向下追溯到相邻区域,但受向上终止逻辑的制约:如果路径向上穿越到之前线程的域中,线索必须立即中止。 这种机制确保每个轮廓都精确地通过包含其光栅扫描切入点的线程提取一次,有效解决了平行处理中固有的重复计算问题. 因此,TRUCO提供了适合需要几何边界数据的应用程序的无锁高通量解决方案,而无需承担构建地形等级的计算负担。 此外,通过将状态空间限制在8位操作上,而不是标准铃木-Abe算法所要求的32位整数标签,TRUCO实现了更高的SIMD吞吐量和降低内存带宽压力,提供了独立于线程计的性能优势.

blocks.en: This approach specifically addresses the gap in current libraries by providing a lightweight, deterministic tracer optimized for modern multi-core architectures. The source code for TRUCO and all necessary materials to reproduce our results are publicly available 1 1 1 https://github.com/rmsalinas/truco .
blocks.zh: 这种方法通过为现代多核心架构提供最优化的轻量级、决定性的跟踪器,专门解决当前库中的差距。 TRUCO的源代码和复制我们结果的一切必要材料可公开查阅 11 1 https://github.com/rmsalinas/truco 。 。 。

Section 5 presents the experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets, and finally, Section 6 presents some conclusions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The extraction and tracing of contours in digital images have been extensively studied, evolving from simple local boundary followers to complex global topological analyzers and, more recently, to data-driven deep learning models.
blocks.zh: 已广泛研究了数字图像中图象的提取和追踪问题,从简单的本地边界追随者演变为复杂的全球地形分析器,最近又演变为数据驱动的深度学习模型。

blocks.en: 2.1 Classical Sequential Tracing Paradigms
blocks.zh: 2.1 经典序列追踪范例

blocks.en: Early contour extraction research focused primarily on local neighborhood analysis [ 22 , 23 , 25 ] . The Square Tracing Algorithm remains the most fundamental non-topological approach, operating on purely reactive logic in which local turns are made based on the current pixel’s state. While conceptually simple, it is highly susceptible to the "stopping problem" and fails in complex 8-connectivity scenarios common in noisy binary masks. A more robust evolution, the Moore-Neighbor Tracing algorithm, utilizes the 8-pixel neighborhood to identify the next boundary point. Although Moore’s algorithm ensures a more reliable trace, it is inherently serial; the identification of the (n+1)-th pixel depends strictly on the coordinates of the n-th pixel. Recent optimizations, such as those by [ 27 ] , introduced pixel-type classification (straight lines, inner corners, and outer corners) to reduce the search space at each step. While these refinements optimize execution on low-power hardware, the fundamental algorithmic complexity remains O(L), where L is the object’s perimeter, leaving it ill-suited for the massive parallelism of modern multi-core systems.
blocks.zh: 早期的轮廓采掘研究主要集中于当地街区分析[22,23,25]. Square Tracking Algorithm仍是最根本的非地形学方法, 虽然在概念上很简单,但它极易受到"阻止问题"的影响,在吵闹的二进制口罩中常见的复杂八连通场景中失败. 一个更强大的进化,摩尔-邻居追踪算法,利用8像素的邻里来识别下一个边界点. 尽管摩尔的算法保证了更可靠的痕量,但它本质上是串行的;(n+1)-th像素的识别严格取决于n-th像素的坐标. 近期的优化,如[27]的优化,引入了像素类型的分类(直线,内角,外角),以减少每步的搜索空间. 虽然这些改进优化了低功率硬件上的执行,但基本的算法复杂性仍然是O(L),而L是物体的周边,因此它不适合现代多核心系统的大规模平行性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Topological connectivity
blocks.zh: 2.2 地形连接

blocks.en: A significant paradigm shift occurred with the Suzuki-Abe algorithm [ 28 ] , which introduced topological structural analysis by establishing a hierarchical tree of contours. While this remains the gold standard for libraries like OpenCV, its O(N×M) complexity imposes a significant global overhead. To mitigate this, [ 5 ] proposed a linear-time algorithm that unifies connected component labeling and contour tracing in a single pass, eliminating redundant pixel scans. Further optimizations, such as block-based decision trees from [ 12 ] , have reduced memory accesses, improving speed. However, for high-performance geometric tasks, such as robotic fiducial detection or path planning, these methods remain burdened by their reliance on global topological structures, which limit their scalability compared to purely coordinate-based approaches.
blocks.zh: 铃木-亚伯算法发生了显著的范式转变[28],该算法通过建立层次轮廓树引入了地形结构分析. 虽然这仍然是OpenCV等图书馆的金本位标准,但其O(N×M)的复杂程度在全球造成了可观的间接费用。 为缓解这种情况,[5]提出了一个线性时间算法,将连接的组件标签和轮廓跟踪统一在一个单传中,消除冗余像素扫描. 进一步的优化,如[12]的块形决策树,减少了内存访问,提高了速度. 然而,对于高性能的几何任务,如机器人微量探测或路径规划,这些方法仍然因为依赖于全球地形结构而负担沉重,这些结构相对于纯粹基于协调的方法来说限制了其可扩展性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Run-Length Encoding Approaches
blocks.zh: 2.3 Run-Length编码方法

blocks.en: To mitigate the overhead of pixel-by-pixel traversal, alternative strategies use Run-Length Encoding (RLE) to efficiently process segments of foreground pixels [ 17 , 24 ] . While Run-Length Encoding (RLE) is frequently associated with region labeling [ 15 ] , early boundary-specific methods [ 3 , 4 ] demonstrated that contours could be extracted directly from raster-ordered runs in a single pass. This process is formalized in the "Link-Run" algorithm, which establishes topological connectivity by examining the spatial overlap between horizontal segments in adjacent scanlines [ 14 ] . By operating on these compressed run data structures rather than individual pixels such methods achieve significantly higher throughput for images with simple geometries [ 17 , 14 ] . However, as with traditional Moore-Neighbor tracing, the linking phase remains inherently sequential; it often struggles to scale effectively on massively parallel architectures due to the intricate data dependencies between adjacent rows. Despite these limitations, the run-based approach is included as a baseline in our experimental analysis to evaluate the efficiency of purely geometric tracing against run-based connectivity.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻像素逐像素转录的间接费用,替代策略使用Run-Length编码(RLE)高效处理前景像素的片段[17,24]. 虽然Run-Length Encoding(RLE)经常与区域标签[15]相关联,但早期的边界特定方法[3,4]表明轮廓可以直接从光栅订购的跑道中抽取到一个单传. 这个过程在"Link-Run"算法中被正式确定下来,该算法通过检查相邻扫描线中水平段之间的空间重叠来建立地形连接[14]. 通过在这些压缩运行的数据结构上运行,而不是单个像素,这些方法对具有简单几何图形的图像实现显著更高的吞吐量[17,14]. 然而,和传统的摩尔-邻里追踪一样,连接阶段仍然具有内在的顺序性;由于相邻行之间的数据依赖性错综复杂,它往往难以在大规模平行的架构上有效扩展. 尽管存在这些局限性,但我们的实验分析中仍将基于运行的方法作为基线,评价纯粹几何跟踪与基于运行的连接的效率。

blocks.en: 2.4 Parallel Contour Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.4 平行采掘

blocks.en: To overcome the sequential limit of traditional contour-following, research has explored various parallelization strategies. Foundational parallel approaches focused on specific contour representations and hardware models. Chen et al. [ 8 ] developed O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N ) O(\log N) algorithms for ranking and linearizing contour pixels on PRAM architectures, enabling efficient subsequent geometric operations. Similarly, Chia et al. [ 9 ] proposed a parallel systolic array architecture to generate chain codes in linear time ( 3 ​ N 3N cycles) without requiring complex backtracking.
blocks.zh: 为了克服传统轮廓的顺序限制,研究探讨了各种平行战略。 基础平行方法侧重于具体的轮廓表示和硬件模型。 陈等. [8]在PRAM架构上开发了O QQ(log QQ N ) O(\log N)算法,用于排列和线性化等效像素,使随后有效的几何操作成为可能. 同样, 千亚等. [9] 提出了并行的序列数组架构,在线性时间(3 N 3N循环)中生成链码,而不需要复杂的回溯跟踪.

blocks.en: More recently, research has prioritized massive parallelization through image tiling and architectural optimizations. Garcia et al. [ 10 , 11 ] introduced a parallel Suzuki-Abe adaptation for both GPUs and CPUs that uses rectangular image partitioning; however, this approach often encounters a "stitching" bottleneck when merging contour segments across tile boundaries. To address this, [ 13 ] proposed a communication-based paradigm for torus-connected architectures that eliminates complex merging phases by assigning pixels to individual processing elements. More recent approaches have explored data structures for massive extraction; [ 30 ] introduced G-Contour, utilizing a parallel Union-Find structure to identify objects before extraction. While extremely fast for images with thousands of small objects, its efficiency can fluctuate with object density.
blocks.zh: 最近,研究将大规模平行化列为优先事项,办法是通过图象板和建筑优化。 Garcia等人[10,11]对使用长方形图像分割的GPU和CPU同时采用了Suzuki-Abe的平行适应;然而,这种方法在将轮廓片段跨越瓦片边界合并时经常遇到"夹缝"瓶颈. 为了解决这个问题,[13]为托鲁斯连接架构提出了一个基于通信的范式,通过给单个处理元素分配像素来消除复杂的合并阶段. 更近期的方法探索了大规模提取的数据结构;[30]引入了G-Contour,使用平行的Union-Find结构在提取前识别对象. 虽然对于拥有数千个小物体的图像来说极快,但其效率可以随物体密度而波动.

blocks.en: 2.5 Deep Learning edge detection
blocks.zh: 2.5 深层学习边缘探测

blocks.en: In the contemporary landscape, state-of-the-art models such as Holistically-Nested Edge Detection (HED) [ 29 ] and Meta’s Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 18 ] have redefined boundary detection through superior zero-shot generalization and semantic awareness. However, these models primarily generate dense pixel-wise probability maps rather than structured geometric entities, creating a critical "post-processing gap." To extract usable coordinates or topological trees, their outputs must still be vectorized using classical algorithms such as the Suzuki-Abe method [ 28 ] or the Chang method [ 5 ] . Consequently, even with advanced neural architectures, the total system throughput remains constrained by the same O(N×M) bottlenecks and the sequential limitations of topological vectorization that classical methods strive to overcome.
blocks.zh: 在当代的地貌中,最先进的模型,如全景边缘探测(HED)[29]和Meta的分段任意模式(SAM)[18],通过优异的零射一般化和语义意识重新定义了边界探测. 然而,这些模型主要生成密集的像素视概率图,而不是结构化的几何实体,从而形成关键的"后处理缺口". 要提取可用的坐标或地形树,它们的输出仍必须使用铃木-亚贝法[28]或昌法[5]等古典算法进行矢量化. 因此,即使有先进的神经结构,总的系统吞吐量仍然受到同样的O(N×M)瓶颈和传统方法努力克服的地形矢量化的顺序限制的限制。

blocks.en: Unlike the aforementioned works, our proposed method focuses on eliminating the synchronization overhead inherent in both topological and tile-based merging strategies. By adopting a speculative execution model and a start-point-invariant geometric hashing for deduplication, we achieve high-throughput parallel tracing without complex stitching logic or hierarchical construction. This approach specifically addresses the gap in current libraries by providing a lightweight, deterministic tracer optimized for modern multi-core architectures.
blocks.zh: 与上述工作不同,我们提议的方法侧重于消除地形和瓷砖合并战略中固有的同步间接费用。 通过采用投机性执行模式和启动点-不变量几何散列来进行分解,我们实现了高通量平行追踪,而没有复杂的缝合逻辑或分级构造. 这种方法通过为现代多核心架构提供最优化的轻量级、决定性的跟踪器,专门解决当前库中的差距。

blocks.zh: 3 铃木阿贝算法

blocks.en: 4.1 Domain Decomposition and State Space

blocks.en: Our approach employs a row-based decomposition to parallelize contour extraction. The input image I I is divided into K K horizontal strips (slices), where each thread T k T_{k} is responsible for a specific range of rows [ i s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t k , i e ​ n ​ d k ) [i_{start}^{k},i_{end}^{k}) .

blocks.en: Unlike the sequential Suzuki-Abe algorithm, which relies on a global integer state ( N ​ B ​ D NBD ) for hierarchy construction, our method focuses on contour retrieval using a simplified state space. We treat the input image as a shared labeling board, utilizing only 4 labels: BACKGROUND , FOREGROUND , and the visited states VISITED and EAST_VISITED . Crucially, the Moore tracing logic treats all non-background states as equivalent to FOREGROUND . This ensures that a pixel marked as visited by one thread remains geometrically valid for another thread performing a speculative trace, preserving the operation’s idempotent nature.
blocks.zh: 与相继的铃木-阿贝算法不同,它依赖于一个全局整数状态(N B D NBD)进行阶梯构造,我们的方法侧重于利用简化状态空间进行轮廓检索. 我们把输入图像当作一个共享的标签板,只使用4个标签:背景、FOREGROUND和受访国家VISTED和East_。 访问。 摩尔追踪逻辑将所有非背景状态视为相当于FOREGROUND。 这保证了用一个线程标记的像素在几何上对另一个线程进行推测性跟踪依然有效,从而保持了操作的独有性.

blocks.en: Crucially, this simplified state space allows the algorithm to operate directly on 8-bit data, in contrast to the standard Suzuki-Abe method, which necessitates a 32-bit integer image to store arbitrarily large contour IDs ( N ​ B ​ D NBD ). This reduction significantly optimizes resource utilization: it not only reduces memory bandwidth pressure but also maximizes vectorized instruction throughput, since more pixels can be processed per CPU cycle than 32-bit integers. These factors contribute to the performance gains observed even in single-threaded execution, as we observe in the experimental Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 关键是,这种简化的状态空间允许算法在8位数据上直接运行,与标准铃木-阿贝方法形成对比,后者需要32位整数图像来任意存储大轮廓ID(N B D NBD ). 这种减少大大优化了资源利用:它不仅降低了内存带宽压力,而且使矢量化的指令吞吐量最大化,因为每个CPU周期处理的像素比32位整数还要多. 正如我们在实验第5节中观察到的那样,这些因素有助于在单行执行中观察到的性能提高。

blocks.en: 4.2 Speculative Tracing Logic
blocks.zh: 4.2 投机追踪逻辑

blocks.en: The core challenge in parallel contour extraction is avoiding double-counting when a contour crosses the boundary between two threads. We resolve this using a start-point ownership rule: a contour belongs to the thread that contains its raster-scan start point (the first pixel encountered in a row-major scan).
blocks.zh: 平行轮廓提取的核心挑战是当一个轮廓跨越两条线之间的边界时避免双重计算. 我们用一个起始点所有权规则来解决这个问题:一个轮廓属于包含其光栅扫描起始点的线程(在行主扫描中遇到的第一个像素).

blocks.en: Since threads operate asynchronously, thread T k T_{k} may encounter a foreground pixel that effectively belongs to a contour started in an upper region (by thread T k − 1 T_{k-1} ) but not yet marked as visited. To handle this without complex locking, we employ a speculative tracing with an upward termination strategy:
blocks.zh: 由于线程同步运行,线程 T k T_{k} 可能会遇到实际上属于从上层区域开始的轮廓的前缘像素(通过线程 T k − 1 T_{k-1}),但尚未被标记为访问对象. 为了在不复杂锁锁的情况下处理此事,我们采用了一种投机性追踪,并采用向上终止策略:

blocks.en: 1. Unrestricted Downward Tracing: A thread is permitted to trace a contour indefinitely downwards into the regions of subsequent threads ( i ≥ i e ​ n ​ d k i\geq i_{end}^{k} ). It marks pixels as it goes, effectively claiming them. 2. Upward Termination (The Abort Condition): If a thread T k T_{k} traces a contour and the path crosses into the upper neighbor’s region (specifically, if the current pixel i < i s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t k i<i_{start}^{k} ), the thread immediately aborts the trace and discards the contour.

blocks.en: A special boundary case arises for hole contours (internal contours) that are detected exactly on the first row of a thread’s slice ( i = i s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t k i=i_{start}^{k} ). Due to the local geometry of holes, the contour path may briefly oscillate into the row immediately above ( i s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t k − 1 i_{start}^{k}-1 ) without actually "belonging" to the upper thread. To prevent false aborts in this scenario, we relax the termination condition specifically for holes. A hole contour trace initiated at i s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t k i_{start}^{k} is not aborted if it touches i s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t k − 1 i_{start}^{k}-1 , provided it does not extend further upward.

blocks.en: 4.4 Synchronization and Memory Model
blocks.zh: 4.4 同步和内存模型

blocks.en: The proposed method is designed to be logically synchronization-free. While threads share the same image buffer I I and may write to adjacent or even identical pixels (in the case of a speculative trace overlapping with a valid trace), these operations are logically benign. The action of marking a pixel as VISITED or EAST_VISITED is idempotent; whether one thread or multiple threads write this value, the final state remains consistent. Consequently, we eliminate the need for explicit execution barriers, mutex locks, or atomic compare-and-swap (CAS) operations, which are traditional sources of latency in multi-core scaling.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法的设计是逻辑同步无阻. 虽然线程共享相同的图像缓冲I I,并可能写给相邻甚至相同的像素(如果是推测的痕量与有效痕量重叠),这些操作在逻辑上是良性的. 将像素标记为 VISITED 或 East_ VISITED是一元论;无论一个线程或多个线程写这个值,最终状态仍然一致. 因此,我们消除了明确执行障碍、变异锁或原子比较和扫描(CAS)操作的必要性,这些是多核心规模中长期存在的传统来源。

blocks.en: However, it is important to note that while we remove software synchronization, the hardware’s cache coherency mechanisms remain active. In scenarios where multiple threads speculatively trace—and thus write to—pixels within the same cache line, false sharing can occur. For typical images with spatially distributed objects, this overlap is negligible. However, in pathological cases where a single contour spans multiple thread domains (such as the spiral stress test discussed in Section 5.3 ), this implicit hardware synchronization can introduce latency due to cache line invalidations, representing a trade-off between algorithmic simplicity and worst-case hardware contention. Therefore, although TRUCO is algorithmically lock-free (no mutexes/atomics), hardware cache coherency protocols may introduce implicit synchronization, especially in pathological cases.
blocks.zh: 然而,必须指出的是,虽然我们取消了软件同步,但硬件的缓存一致性机制仍然活跃. 在多个线程投机地追踪——从而写到——在同一缓存线内的像素的情景中,可能会发生假共享. 对于具有空间分布对象的典型图像,这种重叠是可忽略不计的. 然而,在单个轮廓跨越多个线域的病理案例中(如第5.3节中讨论的螺旋应力测试),这种隐含的硬件同步可以由于缓存线条无效而引入延缓性,代表了算法简单和最坏情况硬件争议之间的权衡. 因此,虽然TRUCO在算法上是无锁的(没有变异/原子),但硬件缓存一致性协议可能引入隐性同步,特别是在病理情况下.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Section
blocks.zh: 5个实验科

blocks.en: The proposed algorithm was benchmarked against three baselines. First, we evaluated the Suzuki-Abe and RLE methods as implemented in OpenCV 4.12 ( findContours and findContourLinkRuns , respectively). To ensure a fair comparison focused strictly on raw tracing throughput, calculations of hierarchical relationships among contours were disabled. Furthermore, we compared our approach against the parallel tiling method introduced by Garcia et al. [ 11 ] . Notably, rigorous validation confirmed that the contours generated by our proposed method are identical to those obtained by the Suzuki-Abe algorithm across all test cases.
blocks.zh: 拟议算法以三个基线作为基准。 首先,我们评价了在OpenCV4.12(分别找到Contours和ContourLinkRuns)中实施的铃木-Abe和RLE方法. 为确保公平比较,严格侧重于原始追踪吞吐量,对轮廓之间的等级关系进行了计算。 此外,我们比较了我们的做法与Garcia等人[11] 采用的平行平板方法。 值得注意的是,严格的验证证实,我们拟议方法产生的轮廓与铃木-阿贝算法在所有试验案件中获得的轮廓相同。

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on two distinct hardware architectures to evaluate cross-platform consistency: 1. Consumer Workstation: A 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13700H (14 cores: 6P+8E, 20 threads, 32GB DDR5 RAM) running Ubuntu 22.04. To ensure consistent benchmarking, Intel Turbo Boost was disabled, and the CPU frequency was fixed at 3.5 GHz. 2. Server Node: An Intel Xeon Silver 4510 (12 cores, 24 threads, 64GB DDR5 RAM) running Ubuntu 22.04. This platform represents a homogeneous core architecture typical of high-performance computing environments. Unless otherwise stated, the detailed breakdown of results refers to the i7-13700H. For the parallel scaling experiments, we limited the Xeon execution to 20 threads to maintain parity with the consumer hardware.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都针对两个不同的硬件结构,以评估跨平台的一致性: 1. 消费者工作站:第13Gen Intel 核心i7-13700H(14个核心:6P+8E,20线,32GB DDR5 RAM)运行Ubuntu 22.04. 为确保连贯一致的基准,Intel Turbo Boost被禁用,CPU频率被固定在3.5GHz. 2. 服务器节点:一个英特尔Xeon Silver 4510(12个核心,24个线程,64GB DDR5 RAM)运行Ubuntu 22.04. 这个平台代表着一种典型的高性能计算环境的同质核心架构. 除非另有说明,结果的详细分类是指i7-13700H. 对于平行的缩放实验,我们把Xeon执行限制在20个线程以保持与消费硬件的对等.

blocks.en: The experimental validation is organized into three subsections. First, we analyze the algorithm’s scalability and robustness to object density using a synthetic dataset. Second, we assess performance on real-world data using the Liu4K [ 19 ] high-resolution dataset to test the method against irregular shapes and noise. Finally, we evaluate the method on pathological images to find its limits.
blocks.zh: 实验论证分为三个小节. 首先,我们分析该算法的可伸缩性和强性,以便利用合成数据集来分析物体密度。 第二,我们利用Liu4K[19]高分辨率数据集对现实世界数据进行性能评估,以测试对不规则形状和噪声的方法. 最后,我们评价病理图像上的方法,以找出其极限.

blocks.en: We generated a synthetic dataset with 40 images (4000 × \times 4000) designed to simulate varying levels of geometric complexity and computational load. The dataset consists of high-resolution images (16 MP) containing a distributed set of small circular foreground objects.

blocks.en: The complexity of each image is controlled by an object density parameter p p , which represents the probability of placing circles. We varied p p from 0.05 0.05 to 0.75 0.75 in increments of 0.05 0.05 . To ensure statistical significance and minimize the impact of random spatial distributions, we generated 5 unique images for each density level. This resulting corpus allows for a granular analysis of how thread divergence and deduplication overhead scale with the number of detected contours. blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the performance of the tested algorithms across increasing image resolutions, ranging from 16MP to 1MP. Each row corresponds to a specific resolution and serves as a benchmark for evaluating how the algorithms handle increasing data volumes. The first column shows the resolution, while the second shows the mean execution time for the standard Suzuki-Abe, which serves as the reference for all speedup calculations. The subsequent columns, RLE, Garcia, and TRUCO(1T), represent the performance gains achieved by the RLE OpenCV algorithm, Garcia et al. [ 11 ] , and our single-thread algorithm, respectively. Finally, the TRUCO(20T) column identifies the peak efficiency achieved by the parallel implementation, which is achieved at 20 threads.
blocks.zh: 表1总结了经过测试的算法在不断增长的图像分辨率上的性能,从16MP到1MP不等. 每行都对应一个特定分辨率,并作为评价算法如何处理增加的数据量的基准. 第一栏显示解析度,第二栏显示标准铃木-阿贝的平均执行时间,作为所有加速计算参考. 随后的列,RLE,Garcia,和TRUCO(1T)分别代表了RLE OpenCV算法,Garcia等人[11]和我们的单线程算法所取得的性能收益. 最后,TRUCO(20T)一栏确定了平行执行达到的最高效率,这是在20线实现的.

blocks.en: The data demonstrates that the proposed algorithm offers a substantial performance advantage across all tested resolutions. A significant portion of this improvement is algorithmic: the single-threaded (1T) version of the proposed method is approximately 2 × 2\times faster than the baseline. This indicates that for spatially distributed objects, the reduced 8-bit state space significantly reduces memory bandwidth pressure compared to the 32-bit baseline, thereby outweighing the overhead of the proposed speculative logic. When parallelism is fully utilized, the algorithm scales robustly, achieving a peak speedup of nearly 20 × 20\times on smaller images. As the resolution increases to 16MP, the peak speedup declines slightly to nearly 14 × 14\times .
blocks.zh: 数据显示,拟议的算法在所有经测试的决议中都具有很大的性能优势。 这种改进的很大一部分是算法性的:提议的方法的单线(1T)版本大约比基线快2×2\时间. 这表明,对于空间分布的物体,与32位基线相比,缩小的8位状态空间大大降低了内存带宽压力,从而超过了拟议投机逻辑的间接费用. 当并列主义被充分利用时,算法的尺度会强劲,在较小的图像上达到近20×20\的峰值速度. 随着分辨率上升至16MP,峰值速度略微下降至近14×14\时.

blocks.en: The architectural robustness is further confirmed by the Xeon results. While the server platform yields slightly lower peak speedups than the i7 (maxing at 12.64 × 12.64\times versus 19.97 × 19.97\times ), the algorithm maintains strong scalability relative to the baseline, demonstrating that the lock-free logic translates effectively to homogeneous server architectures.
blocks.zh: 建筑坚固性进一步得到Xeon结果的证实. 虽然服务器平台的峰值速度比i7稍低(最大为12.64×12.64\时对19.97×19.97\时),但算法相对于基线保持了强大的可伸缩性,表明无锁逻辑有效翻译为同源服务器架构.

blocks.en: Regarding the RLE method, it provides a modest 1.5 × 1.5\times speedup over the baseline, but it consistently underperforms both the single-threaded and parallel versions of the proposed TRUCO algorithm. In stark contrast, the Garcia method exhibits significantly poor performance, achieving only a fraction of the baseline’s speed (between 0.40 × 0.40\times and 0.67 × 0.67\times ) across all tested resolutions. Due to these substantial performance deficits and its inability to compete with other methods, the Garcia algorithm will not be used in subsequent experiments for further evaluation.
blocks.zh: 关于RLE方法,它提供了比基线略微的1.5×1.5\时速的加速,但是它始终没有达到拟议的TRUCO算法的单线和平行版本。 Garcia方法的性能明显不佳, 由于这些巨大的性能缺陷以及它无法与其他方法竞争,加西亚算法将不再用于后续的实验以进一步评价.

blocks.en: Figure 3(b) illustrates the scalability of the proposed TRUCO algorithm across varying resolutions. The speedup increases significantly as the number of threads grows, peaking at a remarkable 19.97 × 19.97\times for 1MP images. Importantly, this robust pattern of improvement is consistent across all tested resolutions, though relative efficiency gracefully tapers as image size increases, dropping to a maximum speedup of 13.97 × 13.97\times for 16MP images. The superior performance on lower-resolution images is likely due to better cache locality, as a larger proportion of the image data can reside in the CPU cache, reducing memory access latency.
blocks.zh: 图3(b)显示拟议的TRUCO算法在不同分辨率上的可扩展性。 随着线程数量的增加,速度大大增加,在1MP图像的显著19.97×19.97\时达到顶峰. 重要的是,这种强劲的改进模式在所有经过测试的分辨率中是一致的,尽管随着图像尺寸的增大,相对效率优雅地将图像切换,16幅MP图像的最高速度降至13.97×13.97\时。 低分辨率图像的优异性能可能是由于缓存位置更好,因为较大比例的图像数据可以存放在CPU缓存中,从而减少了内存访问延迟.

blocks.en: Figure 3(c) details the algorithm’s scalability with respect to both thread count and object density. As anticipated, single-threaded execution is the most sensitive to density variations, with processing time increasing steeply to approximately 35 ms at higher density levels. However, introducing parallelism yields immediate and substantial benefits; for instance, utilizing just two threads nearly halves the total execution time. Furthermore, as the thread count increases, the performance penalty imposed by higher contour densities diminishes significantly. At higher degrees of parallelism, execution time remains exceptionally stable across image complexities, demonstrating TRUCO’s resilience in contour-dense scenarios and effective workload distribution.
blocks.zh: 图3(c)详细说明了算法在线程计数和物体密度方面的可扩展性。 如预期的那样,单线执行对密度变化最为敏感,处理时间在密度较高时会急剧增加至约35 ms. 然而,实行平行制可立即产生实质性好处;例如,只使用两条线几乎使总执行时间减半。 此外,随着线程计数的增加,高密度造成的性能处罚显著减少。 在较高程度的平行状态下,执行时间在图像复杂性方面仍然非常稳定,这表明TRUCO在轮廓复杂的情况下具有弹性,有效分配工作量。

blocks.en: 5.2 Liu4K dataset
blocks.zh: 5.2 刘4K数据集

blocks.en: To validate the proposed method under non-synthetic, practical conditions, we utilized the Liu4K dataset 2 2 2 Liu4K GitHub repository , which provides a diverse collection of high-resolution, real-world scenes. From the original training set, we selected the 924 images with a minimum resolution of 16 megapixels (MP). To ensure consistency across our experiments, all selected images were standardized by resizing them to exactly 16 MP and converting them to JPG.
blocks.zh: 为了在非合成、实用的条件下验证拟议方法,我们利用了Liu4K数据集2 2 Liu4K GitHub寄存器,该数据集提供了多种高分辨率、真实世界的场景。 从最初的训练集中,我们选择了924幅图像,最低分辨率为16兆像素(MP). 为了确保我们实验的一致性,所有选定的图像都实现了标准化,将图像调整为16 MP,并将其转换成JPG。

blocks.en: Unlike synthetic datasets, real-world images inherently require preprocessing to generate the binary inputs necessary for contour extraction. We applied an adaptive thresholding filter (box size: 15, constant: 3) to extract significant edges. This preprocessing step typically produces binary maps characterized by complex, noisy topologies and irregular contour distributions. Consequently, this dataset provides a rigorous stress test for evaluating the algorithm’s load-balancing capabilities and parallel efficiency. Figure 4 illustrates representative samples, displaying both the original color inputs and the resulting binary masks used for the contour extraction process.
blocks.zh: 与合成数据集不同,现实世界的图像内在需要预处理,以生成对等提取所必需的二进制输入. 我们应用了适应性阈值过滤器(框大小:15,常数: 3) 提取显著边缘. 这个预处理步骤一般会产生以复杂,吵闹的地形和不规则的轮廓分布为特征的二进制地图. 因此,该数据集为评价算法的负载平衡能力和平行效率提供了一个严格的压力测试。 图4显示了代表性样品,既显示原始的颜色输入,也显示由此产生的二进制口罩,用于轮廓提取过程.

blocks.en: The quantitative performance results are detailed in Table 2 . The standard Suzuki-Abe algorithm, as implemented in OpenCV, establishes a baseline execution time of 136.25 ms for 16 MP images. The Run-Length Encoding (RLE) algorithm provides a modest but consistent improvement, achieving speedups ranging from 1.37 × 1.37\times to 1.54 × 1.54\times across the tested resolutions. Notably, the single-threaded version of our approach, TRUCO(1T), consistently delivers a ≈ 1.8 × \approx 1.8\times speedup over the OpenCV baseline across all resolutions. This finding is significant: it indicates that the core logic of our proposed contour extraction, specifically the use of 8-bit rather than 32-bit image representations, establishes a substantially higher performance baseline, independent of parallelization.
blocks.zh: 表2详细列出了量化业绩结果。 在OpenCV中实施的标准铃木-Abe算法为16幅MP图像确定了136.25ms的基准执行时间. Run-Length编码(RLE)算法提供适度但一致的改进,实现速度从1.37×1.37\时到1.54×1.54\时不等,跨越测试的分辨率. 值得注意的是,我们方法的单行本TRUCO(1T),在所有分辨率上,始终比OpenCV基线速度快1.8×\\\%。 这个结论很重要:它表明,我们拟议的轮廓提取的核心逻辑,特别是使用8位而不是32位图像表示法,确立了一个显著更高的性能基线,独立于平行化.

blocks.en: The true strength of the proposed method becomes evident under multi-threaded execution. When utilizing 20 threads, TRUCO(20T), the algorithm achieves up to a 10.50 × 10.50\times speedup over the Suzuki-Abe baseline for 16 MP images. Figure 5(a) presents the overall scalability analysis on the Liu4K dataset, demonstrating robust performance scaling across varying thread counts.
blocks.zh: 在多线性执行中,拟议方法的真正力量变得很明显。 当使用20个线程,TRUCO(20T)时,算法在铃木-阿贝基线上对16幅MP图像实现最高10.50×10.50\时的速度. 图5(a)显示对Liu4K数据集的总体可扩展性分析,显示在各种线程计数中强劲的性能规模。

blocks.en: The cross-architecture comparison in Table 2 highlights the method’s reliability. On the computationally demanding 16 MP images, the Xeon server achieves a 9.95 × 9.95\times speedup, virtually matching the 10.50 × 10.50\times obtained on the consumer workstation. This indicates that for heavy, real-world workloads, TRUCO effectively saturates the available throughput regardless of the underlying core topology (hybrid vs. homogeneous).
blocks.zh: 表2的跨结构比较突出了该方法的可靠性。 在计算要求16个MP图像时,Xeon服务器实现了9.95×9.95\时速加速,几乎匹配了消费者工作站获得的10.50×10.50\时速. 这表明,对于现实世界的繁重工作量,TRUCO实际上饱和了现有的吞吐量,而不论核心地形为何(hybrid vs. s.).

blocks.en: To further understand this behavior, Figure 5(b) provides a detailed scalability analysis stratified by image complexity. For this evaluation, the 16 MP dataset was partitioned into three equal-sized categories (Low, Medium, and High complexity) based on the total number of contours present in each image. The results clearly demonstrate that parallel efficiency depends strongly on the workload. For highly complex images, the proposed algorithm exhibits excellent scalability, with the speedup curve closely tracking the ideal linear progression with more threads. In these contour-dense scenarios, the abundance of independent tasks efficiently masks the overhead of thread management. In contrast to the synthetic benchmarks, where lower resolutions yielded higher speedups, the real-world dataset exhibits a slight reduction in parallel efficiency as resolution decreases (from 10.50 × 10.50\times at 16MP to 9.40 × 9.40\times at 1MP). This divergence suggests that the performance balance is sensitive to the nature of the workload.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步理解这种行为,图5(b)提供了按图像复杂程度分级的详细伸缩性分析. 对于这一评价,16 MP数据集根据每个图像中存在的轮廓总数分为三个等大小的类别(低、中和高复杂性)。 结果清楚地表明,平行效率在很大程度上取决于工作量。 对于高度复杂的图像,提议的算法展现出出色的可伸缩性,速度曲线用更多的线程来密切跟踪理想的线性进展. 在这些轮廓密集的情景中,独立任务的丰富性有效地掩盖了线程管理的间接费用。 与合成基准相比,如果分辨率降低,速度提高,则现实世界数据集显示,随着分辨率的降低,平行效率略有下降(从16MP的10.50×10.50\时降至1MP的9.40×9.40\时)。 这一差异表明,业绩平衡对工作量的性质很敏感。

blocks.en: While the uniform, high-density nature of the synthetic tests likely allowed the algorithm to maximize cache locality on small images, the real-world data contains irregular geometries and varying sparsity. In these practical scenarios, as the total pixel count decreases, the fixed overhead of thread management and synchronization may dilute the computational speedup, preventing the massive scaling observed in purely synthetic tests.
blocks.zh: 虽然合成测试的统一性,高密度性质可能允许算法在小图像上最大化缓存位置,但现实世界的数据包含不规则的几何和不同的孢子. 在这些实际情景中,随着总像素计数的减少,线程管理和同步的固定间接费用可能会淡化计算速度,防止在纯合成测试中观察到的大规模缩放.

blocks.zh: 表3:刘4K数据集(i7-13700H)拟议方法速度因子统计分析. '1T ' 表示单线性能, '20T ' 表示达到20线的高峰性能。

blocks.en:
To provide a deeper insight into the algorithm’s reliability, Table 3 presents a detailed statistical breakdown of the speedup factors on the Liu4K dataset.
The analysis of the single-threaded performance, TRUCO(1T), reveals a remarkable consistency across all resolutions.
The mean speedup remains stable at approximately 1.80 × 1.80\times , with a very low standard deviation ( σ ≈ 0.15 \sigma\approx 0.15 ).
Crucially, the minimum recorded speedup never drops below 1.15 × 1.15\times , confirming that the architectural optimizations provide a guaranteed performance floor that strictly outperforms the OpenCV baseline.
blocks.zh:
为了更深入地了解算法的可靠性,表3详细统计了刘4K数据集的速率因素.
对单线性能(TRUCO(1T))的分析显示,所有决议都非常一致。

关键是,最低记录速度从不低于1.15×1.15\时,证实建筑优化提供了保证性能底线,严格超过OpenCV基线.

blocks.en:
In contrast, the parallel performance, TRUCO(20T), exhibits a higher variance ( σ ∈ [ 2.92 , 3.94 ] \sigma\in[2.92,3.94] ), which correlates with the diversity of geometric complexity in real-world scenes. Figure 4 visually illustrates this dichotomy by depicting the dataset’s geometric extremes.
The complex scene on the left, containing 1.4 million contours, corresponds to the best-case scenario in which the abundance of independent tasks allows the algorithm to achieve its peak speedup ( ≈ 23.64 × \approx 23.64\times ).
Conversely, the simple scene on the right (approx. 2500 contours) represents the worst-case scenario ( ≈ 2 × \approx 2\times ), where the synchronization and thread-creation overhead outweigh the computational benefits of parallel processing.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,平行的性能TRUCO(20T)表现出较高的差异(\\\\\[2.92,3.94]\sigma\in[2.92,3.94]),这与现实世界场景中几何复杂性的多样性有关. 图4通过描绘数据集的几何极端来视觉地说明这种二分法。
左侧包含140万轮廓的复杂场景,符合最佳情节,其中独立任务的丰富性使得算法能够实现峰值加速(QQ 23.64 ×\约 23.64\times ).
反之,右侧的简单场景(约2500轮廓)代表了最坏的场景(QQ 2 ×\ 约 2\times),即同步和线程生成的间接费用超过并行处理的计算效益.

blocks.en: 5.3 Worst-Case Stress Tests
blocks.zh: 5.3 最坏情况应激测试

blocks.en: This section analyzes the worst-case scenarios of the proposed method to better understand its limitations.
blocks.zh: 本节分析了拟议方法的最坏情况,以更好地了解其局限性。

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Vertical Stripes
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 纵向条纹

blocks.en: One of the primary theoretical concerns with speculative tracing is the abort penalty. In scenarios where contours are perfectly vertical and span the entire image height, a thread T k T_{k} may trace a contour downwards only to discover it originated in T k − 1 T_{k-1} , forcing a discard. To evaluate the algorithm’s stability under this worst-case condition, we generated a 16 MP image consisting entirely of vertical 1-pixel stripes spaced 1 pixel apart. Figure 6 (a) shows a portion of the image, and Figure 6 (b) displays the results obtained by the tested methods extended up to 20 threads.
blocks.zh: 投机性追踪的主要理论关切之一是堕胎处罚。 在轮廓完全垂直并横跨整个图像高度的情景中,一条线形Tk T_{k}可能只向下追踪一个轮廓,以发现它起源于Tk−1 T_{k-1},从而迫使一个丢弃物. 为了评估算法在这种最坏情况下的稳定性,我们生成了一个完全由垂直的1像素条纹组成的16 MP图像,将1像素分隔开来. 图6(a)显示图像的一部分,图6(b)显示通过试验方法获得的结果,延伸至20个线程。

blocks.en: The results reveal two critical insights: first, even with the overhead of speculative checks, our single-threaded implementation executes significantly faster than the OpenCV baseline, achieving a 1.50 × 1.50\times speedup. Second, the speedup peaks at 2.06 × 2.06\times with 5 threads. Beyond this point, the probability of thread contention increases because every vertical line traverses every thread’s domain, meaning that adding threads increases the ratio of aborted work to valid work.
blocks.zh: 结果揭示了两个关键的见解:第一,即使有了投机性检查的间接费用,我们的单线执行速度大大快于OpenCV基线,实现了1.50×1.50\时速的速度。 二,提速高峰为2.06×2.06\时,有5条线. 在此点之后,线程发生争吵的概率会增加,因为每个垂直线程会穿越每个线程的域,这意味着加入线程会增加被中止的工作与有效工作的比例.

blocks.en: While TRUCO is optimized for natural images with spatially distributed contours, this stress test shows that the method degrades gracefully. It avoids catastrophic failure and instead reverts to a performance level comparable to the industry standard, ensuring reliability even in pathological geometric scenarios. Finally, the RLE method performs very poorly in this scenario, yielding a speedup of just 0.16 × 0.16\times .
blocks.zh: 虽然TRUCO对具有空间分布轮廓的自然图像进行了优化,但这种应力测试表明,该方法的降解优雅. 它避免灾难性的失败,而是恢复到与行业标准相当的性能水平,即使在病理几何情景中也确保可靠性. 最后,RLE方法在这种情景下表现非常差,只产生0.16×0.16\时速的速度.

blocks.en: 5.3.2 The Spiral

Next, to identify the algorithm’s operational floor, we evaluated a single-spiral scenario: a 16 MP image containing a single continuous contour spiraling from the center, as shown in Figure 6 (c). This structure forces serialization and exposes specific processing costs.
blocks.zh: 其次,为了确定算法的操作底线,我们评价了一个单螺旋假想:一个16 MP图像,包含一个来自中心的单一连续轮廓螺旋,如图6(c)所示. 这种结构迫使序列化,暴露出具体的处理成本.

blocks.en: The results, shown in Figure 6 (d), reveal that the single-threaded implementation outpaces the Suzuki-Abe baseline, achieving a 1.14 × 1.14\times speedup. Parallel execution yields modest gains, peaking at a 1.28 × 1.28\times speedup with 6 threads, and hovering around 1.20 × 1.20\times across the 20-thread spectrum.
blocks.zh: 图6(d)显示的结果显示,单线执行速度超过了铃木-阿贝基线,实现了1.14×1.14的提速. 平行执行产生适量增益,峰值为1.28×1.28\时速加速6个线程,徘徊在1.20×1.20°时速左右,跨越20个线程频谱.

blocks.en: Because multiple threads speculatively trace and modify the same contour in this scenario, they likely trigger severe cache coherency traffic (false sharing) that stalls the primary owner thread, preventing massive scaling. However, the crucial takeaway is that TRUCO never degrades below the baseline in this scenario. This confirms that while purely serial space-filling curves limit parallel scalability, the optimized 8-bit state space still provides enough raw efficiency to outperform traditional sequential tracers. Finally, the RLE method achieves a speedup of 0.37 × 0.37\times in this test.
blocks.zh: 由于多线程在这种情景中推测追踪并修改了相同的轮廓,它们可能触发严重的缓存一致性流量(假共享),从而拖住主所有者线程,防止大规模缩放. 然而,关键的外卖是,在这种情况下,TRUCO从未降解到低于基线的水平。 这证实,虽然纯粹的串行空间填充曲线限制了平行的可伸缩性,但优化后的8位状态空间仍然提供了足够的原始效率,以超越传统的顺序跟踪器. 最后,RLE方法在本测试中实现了0.37×0.37\时速的速度.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: TRUCO provides a novel parallel framework for binary contour extraction that prioritizes geometric throughput by optimizing the scanning process for multi-core architectures. By eliminating the need for mutexes, atomic operations, or complex boundary-merging logic, the method achieves a performance floor that is significantly faster than the standard Suzuki-Abe implementation, even in single-threaded execution.
blocks.zh: TRUCO为二进制轮廓提取提供了一个全新的平行框架,通过优化多核心架构的扫描过程,优先排序几何吞吐量. 通过消除对突变,原子操作,或复杂的边界合并逻辑的需要,该方法实现了一个显著快于标准铃木-阿贝执行的性能底线,即使在单线执行中也是如此.

blocks.en: The start-point ownership rule and speculative tracing logic facilitate efficient workload distribution, allowing the algorithm to scale robustly across varying thread counts and image resolutions. Unlike tile-based approaches that struggle with stitching overhead, TRUCO’s speculative model handles complex contours naturally and degrades gracefully in pathological geometric scenarios such as infinite spirals or dense vertical stripes.
blocks.zh: 起始点所有权规则和投机性追踪逻辑有助于高效的工作量分配,使算法能够在各种线程计数和图像分辨率之间强力扩大。 与以瓦片为基础的方法与缝合高架不同,TRUCO的投机模型自然地处理复杂的轮廓,并在无穷螺旋或密集的垂直条纹等病理几何情景中优雅地降解.

blocks.en: Furthermore, experimental validation on both consumer (Intel i7) and server (Intel Xeon) architectures demonstrates the algorithm’s portability. The consistent performance observed across hybrid and homogeneous core topologies confirms that the lock-free logic effectively saturates available throughput regardless of the specific hardware configuration. This approach offers a practical, architecture-agnostic solution for real-time applications in robotics and high-speed inspection where rapid geometric boundary data is essential.
blocks.zh: 此外,在消费者(英特尔i7)和服务器(英特尔Xeon)架构上的实验验证都证明了算法的可移植性. 在混合和同质核心地形上观察到的一致性能证实,无论具体的硬件配置如何,无锁逻辑有效饱和了可用的吞吐量. 这种方法为机器人和高速检查中的实时应用提供了实用的,结构-不可知的解决方案,其中快速几何边界数据至关重要.
